meta: Read "AI will soon replace your job" headlines without panicking: read closely and the article usually says something much smaller.

muc.title: A headline that keeps you up
muc.text: Headlines saying AI will replace this or that job cause panic, but read closely and the article usually says something smaller.

muc.title: Where the prediction comes from
muc.text: See whether the prediction comes from research with data, or from a company selling AI products.

muc.title: A job is many tasks
muc.text: A job is made of many small tasks. Ask a chatbot to split yours into tasks: which ones AI can help with and which need a person.

muc.title: Practice instead of panicking
muc.text: Instead of panicking, pick one task AI can help with and practice using it every week. People who know how to use AI usually have an edge.

muc.title: Ten tasks in your job
muc.text: Ask AI to list ten tasks in your job and mark which ones need a human.
